plainText:
Volume 2 is the second of four omnibus volumes of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. It was published by Shogakukan Asia in , although it uses VIZ Media's translation. This volume contains all the chapters originally found in and .

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Slugging It Out with Slugma
I'm Your Biggest Fan, Donphan
Plugging Past Electrike I
Plugging Past Electrike II
Not So Fetching Feebas
On the Loose and Hyper With Zangoose and Seviper I
On the Loose and Hyper With Zangoose and Seviper II
Hanging Around With Slaking I
Hanging Around With Slaking II
Hanging Around With Slaking III
Bubble Bubble Toil and Azumarill I
Bubble Bubble Toil and Azumarill II
Assaulted by Pelipper I
Assaulted by Pelipper II
Mixing It Up with Magcargo
Mind-Boggling with Medicham
It's Absol-lutely a Bad Omen
What Would You Do for a Whismur?
Going to Eleven with Loudred & Exploud I
Going to Eleven with Loudred and Exploud II
Short Shrift for Shiftry
I More Than Like You, Luvdisc I
I More Than Like You, Luvdisc II
Tanks, but No Tanks, Anorith and Lileep
I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!

==Major events==
 
escapes from the Submarine Explorer 1.
fights New Mauville's power generator. Wattson thanks her by giving her the .
Ruby catches a .
Norman battles Ruby at the Weather Institute. He lets his son compete at Pokémon Contests.
Matt lures Sapphire into the Mt. Chimney cable car by using Flannery as a bait. Sapphire defeats him.
Team Aqua manages to end the volcanic activity of Mt. Chimney.
Tabitha helps Flannery in her attempt to revive Mt. Chimney.
defeats Flannery.
participates in, and wins, Normal Rank Pokémon Contests in all in categories.
Ruby meets Wanda.
Team Magma blow the Rusturf Tunnel up.
Courtney asks Ruby to join Team Magma.
The Gym Leaders hold a crisis meeting in Fortree City.
Ruby participates in Super Rank Pokémon Contests.
Ruby meets Wallace and becomes his student.
Ruby and Sapphire encounter one another again.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Sapphire catches a in PS205.
Ruby catches a Feebas in PS208.
joins Ruby's team in PS211.

===Evolutions===
Chic evolves into in PS195.
Rono evolves into in PS195.
Kiki evolves into in PS196.
Nana evolves into in PS196.
Mumu evolves into in PS200.
Sapphire's Chic into in PS226.

==Gym battles==
defeats Wattson in PS205.
Sapphire battles Winona in PS226, but loses.

==Pokémon Contests==
Ruby wins Normal Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in PS217.
Ruby wins Super Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in PS223.
